name: hcapp_setOfficialTrail
description: Sets or removes ONE trail-type lane of a run's official trail (E5.F6.S6): a scout's pre-run, a runner's track promoted from the PackTrack map, or an uploaded GPX/TCX/FIT file. Other lanes are kept. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 148, @param NULL). Permission: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'createEditRuns' on the run's kennel, hare-scoped (a hare of this run — HasherEventMap.IsHare — passes as the run editor does). Points are [lat, lon] or [lat, lon, t] with t = ms after the lane's first point. The lanes are stored COMPRESSed in HC.Event.OfficialTrailGzip ({"lanes":[{"type","points"}]}) and summarised in HC.Event.OfficialTrailInfo ({"lanes":[{type, distanceM, points, source, sourceRef, setBy, setAt}]}). A trail-only UPDATE: HC.trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForEvent does not stamp updatedAt, so no phone re-downloads the run. Callers: the app (official_trail_service.dart, run_tabs.dart), the API's TrackImportFunctions, hcapp_authorizeTrackFile and tools/promote_best_tracks.py.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run. Must exist with deleted = 0, or the caller is refused as 'Not allowed' (14700).

parameters.name: trailType
parameters.description: Lane: 1 Walkers, 2 Short, 3 Normal, 4 Long, 5 Ballbreaker, >= 100 the kennel's own types. NULL or < 1 returns 14701.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: JSON array [[lat,lon,t?],...]. NULL or '' REMOVES this lane. Otherwise must be a JSON array of at least two points and at most 4,000,000 characters (14701).

parameters.name: distanceM
parameters.description: Trail length in metres, recorded in the lane's info (not validated).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: 'scout' | 'promote' | 'file' — recorded in the lane's info (not validated).

parameters.name: sourceRef
parameters.description: The promoted runner's public id, or the uploaded file name — recorded in the lane's info.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth: 1348 device not registered / type 3, 1148 bad token / type 1, signed-out device / type 7) returns this detail rowset ALONE. The SP's own refusals return {success:0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0 and this detail at index 1: 14700 not allowed (errorType 13), 14701 bad trail (2), 14702 unhandled (5). No debugMessage column.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Index 0 on 14700 / 14701 / 14702, followed by the detail at index 1.

rowsets.name: OfficialTrailInfo
rowsets.description: On success: the run's lane summary after the change, so the screen repaints.

columns.name: OfficialTrailInfo
columns.description: HC.Event.OfficialTrailInfo JSON {"lanes":[...]}; NULL when the last lane was removed.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Event SET OfficialTrailGzip, OfficialTrailInfo (read under UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) — trail columns only; the Event updatedAt trigger leaves updatedAt alone, so nothing re-syncs.
INSERT LOG.GeneralLog (LogSource 'officialTrail', 'lane set' | 'lane removed') for every change.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 14700 / 14701 and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).

codeSmells.detail: Line 73 declares @remove BIT. The project bans BIT (SMALLINT everywhere); harmless here but it is the pattern that gets copied.

codeSmells.issue: A missing run reads as 'Not allowed'
codeSmells.detail: Line 50 resolves the kennel with deleted = 0; a deleted or unknown @eventId leaves @kennelId NULL, @allowed stays 0 and the caller gets 14700 'Only this run's hares and kennel admins…' rather than a not-found error.
Lines 8-9. A file name longer than 500 characters is cut without error. It only lands in the OfficialTrailInfo JSON, so nothing breaks, but the stored reference is not what the client sent.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
